name: task_queue
description: Wraps core/taskqueue.py's TaskQueue as path-addressable CCOS capabilities — create/inspect/update a persistent subtask queue by its JSON file path, loading/saving on each call since capability calls are stateless

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_create
capabilities.description: Create a new task queue, persist it to disk, and return its file path

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_add
capabilities.description: Add a task (by description) to a queue on disk. Mutates queue state.

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_mark_running
capabilities.description: Mark a task in a queue as running and persist. Mutates queue state.

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_mark_done
capabilities.description: Mark a task in a queue as done (with an optional result) and persist. Mutates queue state.

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_mark_failed
capabilities.description: Mark a task in a queue as failed (with an optional error) and persist. Mutates queue state.

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_status
capabilities.description: Return a snapshot of a queue's state: tasks, pending/done counts, completion, current task

capabilities.name: coding.taskqueue_list
capabilities.description: List all saved task queues (newest first) with path and summary status

author: CCOS
